title: At the market
instructions: Peter pazarda meyve sebze alıyor. Miktarlara ve toplam fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: seller
script.text: Good morning! What would you like?

script.speaker: peter
script.text: Good morning. A kilo of tomatoes, please.

script.speaker: seller
script.text: Sorry, I don't have any oranges today. I have nice apples.

script.speaker: peter
script.text: OK, then six apples, please. And are these bananas from Spain?

script.speaker: peter
script.text: Fine. I'll take some bananas too. How much is that?

questions.prompt: How many tomatoes does Peter buy?
questions.feedback: Peter bir kilo (a kilo of) domates alıyor. Altı, elmaların sayısı.
Satıcının bugün portakalı yok (I don't have any oranges today).
questions.evidence: Sorry, I don't have any oranges today.

questions.feedback: Toplam yedi pound elli (seven pounds fifty).
